# go-music-dl AI API

Only player control is AI-specific. Every other operation uses the existing go-music-dl route; there are no parallel AI search, playlist, source-switch, download, or library routes.

Start:

- `GET {base}/api/ai/index`
- `GET {base}/search?q=周杰伦&type=song&sources=qq&sources=netease`

Discover:

- Rankings: `GET {base}/toplists`
- Ranked songs: `GET {base}/toplist_songs?source=...&toplist_id=...`
- Playlist categories: `GET {base}/playlist_categories`
- Category playlists: `GET {base}/category_playlists?source=...&category_id=...`
- Recommendations: `GET {base}/recommend`
- Account playlists: `GET {base}/user_playlists`

Details:

- Playlist: `GET {base}/playlist?id=...&source=...`
- Album: `GET {base}/album?id=...&source=...`

Playback and downloads:

- Player state: `GET {base}/api/ai/player/state`
- Play a searched or explicit song: `POST {base}/api/ai/player/play`
- Control current playback: `POST {base}/api/ai/player/command`
- Source switch: `GET {base}/switch_source?name=...&artist=...&source=...&target=...`
- Playback resolution check: `GET {base}/inspect` (`preview_only=true` is playable)
- Audio stream: `GET {base}/download?...&stream=1`
- Lyrics: `GET {base}/lyric`
- Queue status: `GET {base}/api/downloads/queue`
- Enqueue songs: `POST {base}/api/downloads/queue`
- Enqueue a complete container: `POST {base}/api/downloads/queue/container`

Library and health:

- Local music: `GET {base}/local_music?offset=0&limit=50`
- Local collections: `GET {base}/collections`
- Collection songs: `GET {base}/collections/{id}/songs`
- Health: `GET {base}/healthz`

`{base}` defaults to `/music`. The runtime index is the source of truth for parameters. Existing search, playlist, album, ranking, recommendation, and category routes return the normal rendered page. Preserve a song's `extra` object because some platforms require it for playback or lyrics. Treat `preview_only=true` as playable; do not switch sources just because it is a preview. Player controls require an open web or desktop player; otherwise the route returns `409 player_not_connected`. With multiple players, pass `client_id`. Without it, the default prefers a connected, playing, visible player and uses stable connection order. A full command queue returns `503 player_busy`; disconnected clients expire after 10 minutes. Player writes must send `X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest`. Do not expose cookies, login, or configuration routes to an AI client.
